Tests that identical chat requests return cached response

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
client = LiterLlm.create_client_from_json('{"api_key":"your-api-key","cache":{"backend":"memory","max_entries":256,"ttl_seconds":300}}')
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4'))
puts result.inspect
```
